data.exact_reserve_text: Reinsurers' share of technical provisions has increased from $476.3m to $684.8m, attributable to increased provisions for unearned premiums and claims in line with increased ceded premiums and a deterioration in the loss experience for certain contracts. Gross technical provisions have decreased from $4,263.1m to $4,213.5m, largely due to the effect of currency fluctuation, particularly in relation to Pound Sterling.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were $3,442.3m. Using the gross cumulative claims development table, older underwriting years (2014 and prior) show a net adverse re-estimation totalling approximately $481.0m (about 14.0% of opening gross reserves), i.e. a gross strengthening of reserves. The report links movements to a deterioration in loss experience for certain contracts and higher exposure to natural catastrophe events (Canadian wildfires, Hurricane Matthew, New Zealand earthquakes); increased ceded premiums and movements in reinsurers' share are also noted. No single quantified gross prior-year release amount is stated in narrative, so the PYD figure is calculated from the gross claims development triangle.

Reinsurers' share of technical provisions has increased from $476.3m to $684.8m, attributable to increased provisions for unearned premiums and claims in line with increased ceded premiums and a deterioration in the loss experience for certain contracts.
Gross technical provisions have decreased from $4,263.1m to $4,213.5m, largely due to the effect of currency fluctuation, particularly in relation to Pound Sterling.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from balance sheet liabilities (gross claims outstanding, prior-year column). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' sentence was provided; prior-year development was calculated from the gross cumulative claims development triangle (pages 38-39). The triangle contains an aggregated '2010 and prior' column which was excluded per rules. Amounts reported are in the report currency (USD millions) despite field names referencing 'gbp_m'. Per-lob reserve movements are not disclosed; lob_movements are therefore indeterminate. Currency fluctuations and reinsurance recoverables affect comparatives and may distort movements.
